title: Enabling a new streaming mode in service discovery under heavy load

source.note: Adapted from Roblox's 73-hour outage (Oct 28-31, 2021): Consul streaming under high load plus BoltDB freelist behaviour.

input.objective: Cut CPU and network load on the service-discovery cluster, which is approaching its limits as the fleet grows.
constraints: Every service resolves dependencies through this cluster; it has no fallback.
The change should be live before the holiday traffic peak in 6 weeks.
input.context: A single Consul cluster (5 voting servers) backs service discovery, KV config and locks for ~18,000 nodes and thousands of services. Clients use blocking queries (long polling) on health endpoints; profiling shows most server CPU spent serving these. Consul 1.10 offers 'streaming', a push-based alternative to blocking queries that the vendor reports reduces server CPU and network substantially. Consul persists Raft logs in BoltDB.
input.proposed_solution: Enable streaming for all services' health subscriptions in one rollout: upgrade agents and servers to 1.10, set `use_streaming_backend = true` on clients, and verify in staging (200 nodes) that CPU drops. Streaming is the vendor-recommended path for large clusters, and staging already showed a 60% CPU reduction on servers.
input.environment: Consul 1.10, on-prem bare metal, no secondary discovery cluster.

ground_truth.material_issue: A brand-new subsystem is enabled fleet-wide on the single critical dependency based on a 200-node staging test that cannot reproduce production write/read concurrency; any contention bug or storage pathology takes down everything, with no fallback. Should roll out gradually per service/datacenter with an instant per-client toggle back to blocking queries, load-test at production scale, and reduce blast radius (separate clusters for discovery vs KV).
required_observations: Staging at 200 nodes does not represent production load/concurrency
Single critical cluster with no fallback: fleet-wide enablement maximises blast radius
Gradual per-service rollout with a fast toggle back, scale load testing, isolation of workloads
